prompt: Run a provider-neutral action plan that writes a scoped UI/UX artifact, checkpoints the run, and resumes from the local checkpoint without losing completed action history.
expected_outcomes: Checkpoint is written atomically under the run directory
Resume restores task, authority, role and completed action history
Local resumability is not mislabeled as distributed durable execution
must_not: Claim Temporal-grade durability from a local JSON checkpoint
Discard completed action history on resume
Write checkpoint state outside the project run directory
